info.title: Similarity
info.description: Semantic and federated search across a wiki farm — the READER half of the pair, with wiki-plugin-semindex as the writer. These routes are served by this plugin’s own server and described here rather than mounted by the farm. Most of them could not be mounted: they gate on the caller, count requests per address, pass bytes through from disk, or answer with status codes that carry meaning — and a farm handler is a plain function that never sees the request.

get.description: Every site on this farm carrying a semantic index, with how many pages are in it. Reads the index files off disk; no embedding, so it is cheap.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Comma-separated globs, or the words PUBLIC, LOCAL and PRIVATE.

get.description: The whole vector file for a site, passed through from disk rather than re-serialised — which is why the farm could not mount this even if it wanted to: a handler returns a value, not bytes.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Which site. Defaults to the one you asked.

500.description: The index file could not be read.

get.summary: Turn one text into a vector
get.description: Embeds a string with this farm's model. Distinct from semindex's embed route, which is the writer's and is rate-limited; this one is the reader's.

503.description: The embedder is down — a distinct code, because it means try later rather than try differently.

get.summary: Which model, and is it up
get.description: The model, its dimensions, and the state of the embedder supervisor — or, where the farm delegates embedding elsewhere, the address it delegates to.

post.description: Searches the farm semantically and answers with a wiki page rather than a result list. Optionally continues into peer farms. Takes a JSON body, which the farm cannot express as a mounted operation today — it reads query parameters only.

post.summary: Which site should this page go on?
post.description: Aggregates the semantic page scan per domain and ranks the farm's sites for a topic: 0.7 × mean of the top 5 page similarities + 0.3 × site-centroid similarity. Forked pages count for every site that carries them. Send a title plus first paragraphs — the embedder truncates around 512 tokens. Takes a JSON body.

200.description: A wiki page of ranked sites, or flat JSON when format is 'flat'.

get.description: Semantic search across the sites of this farm, answered as a page. Explicit hostnames that are not on disk are searched over HTTP through the galaxy cache instead.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Which sites — globs, or PUBLIC, LOCAL, PRIVATE.

parameters.name: farms
parameters.description: Comma-separated peer farms to continue the search into.

get.description: Searches sites this farm does not hold, over HTTP, through the galaxy cache. Unlike farm-search the sites must be named — there is no glob over somebody else’s farm.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Ask for the raw outcome instead of a page.

200.description: A wiki page of results, or the flat outcome.

get.description: A capability probe another farm reads before asking anything of this one. Static, cached for an hour, and costs no embedding. A 404 or HTML here means the plugin is absent — which is the answer it is really there to give. It advertises no grants: what this farm will actually answer is decided per site, and only when asked.

200.description: What this farm is and whether it federates.

post.summary: Search on behalf of another farm
post.description: Federated search from a peer. Two keys must turn: the farm admin’s ceiling, and each site’s own grants page. The scope for a caller is exactly the union of sites that granted it — one site’s grant never opens the farm. Login-to-view sites are excluded unconditionally. Guarded by hop limit, request-id dedup, and rate limits keyed on the caller’s address, none of which a farm-mounted handler could apply, because it never sees the request.

200.description: Results from the sites that granted this caller.

403.description: No site on this farm grants federated search to that origin.

429.description: Too many requests from this caller, or from everyone at once.

get.description: Delegates: to a remote indexer if one is configured, otherwise to semindex in this process, otherwise it says plainly that there is none. Owner or admin only in the local case.

parameters.name: domains
parameters.description: Comma-separated globs naming which sites to index.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Rebuild even where the index looks current.

403.description: Not the owner or an admin.

409.description: The local indexer is not running as a writer.

501.description: No indexer at all — install semindex, point at a remote one, or let indexes arrive by sync.

502.description: The remote indexer could not be reached.

page_count.description: Null when the index exists but could not be counted.

embedder.description: The supervisor’s state, or {via, url} where embedding is delegated elsewhere.

live.description: Embed the query now rather than reusing a cached vector.

farms.description: Peer farms to continue into. At most eight are asked.

origin.description: The farm asking. Grants are keyed on this.

hops.description: How far this request has already travelled. This farm accepts zero.

requestId.description: Used to drop a request that arrives twice.

format.description: 'flat' answers plain JSON with per-site scores and evidence; default answers a wiki page.
